pages.text: Altered from $(5)Depth Strider$(), $(4)Pyromania$() increases speed when on fire. Maximum level is $(4)III$() and it conflicts with $(5)Depth Strider$(), $(5)Frost Walker$() and $(4)Proliferation$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: It is best used in the Nether or alongside the Fervour execration. Being affected by Existential Burn will also enable the speed boost.
